environment: Local Vite development server, Go API, PostgreSQL 16.14 isolated qa05_browser schema, temporary private attachment directory; synthetic accounts in independent in-app browser and Chrome sessions

checks.name: auth_and_topology
checks.detail: Login, logout and logged-out reload; administrator created a category and TEXT channel; member could read the channel and its unread count cleared on open.

checks.name: text_and_dm
checks.detail: TEXT send/history; two-person DM create, send, edit, reply and search. Recipient saw create and edit without reload after WebSocket connection and presence showed both sessions online.

checks.name: keyboard_focus
checks.detail: At 1024 CSS px the members drawer exposed modal semantics, trapped Shift+Tab, closed with Escape and returned focus to its opener. Ctrl+K ignored the TEXT composer; outside it search focused its query and Escape returned focus to the search trigger after the fix in 06a5517.

checks.name: responsive_text_view
checks.detail: TEXT view inspected at 1440, 1280 and 1024 CSS px; measured document width did not exceed viewport at these widths.

checks.name: frontend_validation
checks.detail: Vitest: 158 files, 463 tests passed; vue-tsc and Vite production build passed.

checks.name: full_candidate_acceptance
checks.detail: A pinned production bundle, reset completion, browser upload, nonparticipant HTTP ACL, zoom 125/150%, screen-reader pass, voice/media/reconnect and stored screenshot comparison remain to be checked.

limitations: The browser used a local development server and synthetic data, so this evidence cannot close the fixed-candidate release gate.
Screenshots were inspected during the run but not stored as a comparison artifact; DES-08 remains open.
No pinned LiveKit service or physical media devices were present.
